description: The OS Emergency Services Gazetteer is Ordnance Survey's national gazetteer of the locations and names of places and objects, designed for Protection of Life uses such as incident response, planning and coordinating emergency responses, situational awareness and incident reporting. It combines names from several Ordnance Survey products so that call handlers and responders can find locations quickly and accurately, including places without postal addresses. Coverage is Great Britain in the ETRS89 reference system, updated monthly and supplied as an online download from the OS Data Hub. Access is free for members of the Public Sector Geospatial Agreement, which includes emergency services and public bodies; other organisations can trial it under a Data Exploration licence or obtain it through an OS partner, and free sample data in GeoPackage and CSV cover Exeter, Newport and Inverness. Caveats: the full product is not open data, and the gazetteer gives locations and names, not incidents or resources. Simulation uses: geocoding emergency calls and incident records for response time analysis, and building a common location reference for multi-agency emergency simulations. Related records: the FCC 911 master PSAP registry (data-fcc-911-master-psap-registry) lists US emergency call centres and the London Fire Brigade incident records (data-london-fire-brigade-incident-records) are incident data that such gazetteers geocode.
